I can't see one on file, so I won't promise anything. The team is offline right now. They'll pick this up today at 10am ET, and the answer will come to (email hidden)

Your $100 code, HD-••••••, is ready to use whenever you are. Is there anything else I can help with?
No I just like to have options as I am looking at different products.
Used the chat-interview skill

That makes sense. When you're ready to compare, I can pull live prices and ship dates on anything you're looking at.

Before you go, one quick question: you've been looking at both the B30 bundles and the NerdOctaxe. What's making it hard to choose between a bigger unit and a smaller in-stock one?
I'm awaiting my B30 and just going through Nerd Octaxe specifications for tuning assistance.

Thanks, Jorge, that helps. For tuning your NerdOctaxe, our Discord is the quickest place to get help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf . Post in the server and mention @nullhashrate (that's JD). He and the community are very active there.

If you push past the factory settings, that's at your own risk, and it may void the warranty if excess voltage, frequency or heat damages the unit. Keep an eye on the ASIC temperatures as you go.

One last question: what are you after with the tuning, more hashrate or lower power and noise?
All 3

Fair enough. Just know they pull against each other. More hashrate means more power and more fan noise, so the realistic goal is the best hashrate you can get at a power and noise level you're happy with. JD and the folks on Discord are good at finding that balance for your setup.

You've got your $100 code, and Georges will email you about the review code. Enjoy the tuning, Jorge.
Highly appreciated thank you and happy holidays
Thank you, Jorge, and happy holidays to you too. I hope the B30 gets to you soon.
I also just received my power meter please thank Georges & team for this add on for my B30.
Glad it got to you, Jorge. That's the Power K. that came free with your B30. Your thanks will reach Georges and the team, and they'll be happy to hear it. Enjoy it when the B30 lands.

Hopefully soon its been pushed back one to many times unfortunately not meeting the shipping dates as promised even with a 2 week delay as advertised. I understand things like supply chains and logistics can get in the way but customer sentiment decreases i know I'm not as excited since the longer I mine the more I realize this might not be a community I belong in no matter how much I tried to get in just unable to compete with these enthusiasts having stronger rigs. I apologize it is late for me just had this on my mind for quite some time. More and more miners are coming out and well I'm still waiting. I understand its hard to keep a happy customer but so far I've stuck around and new. Anyways thank you for your time. Happy Holidays!

Jorge, you don't need to apologise. You've waited since July 27. We gave you September 30, then early November, then November 15, and missed every one. That's on us, not on manufacturing hiccups, and I'm sorry. The date we gave you earlier today is still the latest one, and tracking will be emailed to you the moment your B30 ships.

On the community side, you belong. Mining at home isn't a race against the big rigs. It's about stacking sats and having a shot at a block, and a B30 is a real step up for that.

Happy holidays.
